chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb from one of them who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): I am a man with a debt. Should I borrow money and perform Hajj? He said: It is better to pay off the debt.
ai.seo_question: Should I pay off my debts before performing Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the priority of settling debts over performing Hajj, emphasizing that financial obligations to others take precedence due to the rights of the creditor (Haqq al-Abd). This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that Hajj is not validly performed if one is burdened by unpaid debts, as the pilgrim must be free from the claims of others to ensure the ritual's acceptance.
